response.sql: WITH qualifying_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'), per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(avg_tat_difference) AS avg_patient_tat_difference FROM per_patient

assumptions.assumption: The '-' U-PRO and RA results must occur in the same laboratory record.

alternatives.interpretation: The two '-' results may occur in different laboratory records for the same patient.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS u WHERE u.ID = l.ID AND u.`U-PRO` = '-') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS r WHERE r.ID = l.ID AND r.RA = '-') GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(avg_tat_difference) AS avg_patient_tat_difference FROM per_patient
